purpose: Generate complete Scarlet anatomical assets, stage them in a rig-ready PSD hierarchy, and leave final placement and scaling to the owner in Photoshop.

portrait.role: Authoritative identity, face, hair, neck, visible torso, rendering, color, and detail reference.

tpose.role: Secondary geometry reference for arms, hands, legs, boots, and body regions absent from the portrait. It never overrides portrait identity.

structural_reference.role: Reference for PSD hierarchy, anatomical separation, clipping, blend modes, and z-order only.
forbidden_uses: copying or transforming Poopoo pixels into Scarlet artwork
using Poopoo colors, identity, anatomy, costume, textures, or shaders as Scarlet artwork
treating the less-articulated Poopoo limbs as sufficient for Scarlet

asset_policy.construction: Generate every anatomical part as independent new artwork guided exclusively by the Scarlet portrait or T-pose.
asset_policy.native_asset_rule: Remove the generated chroma background and trim to the true alpha silhouette. Do not scale or register automatically.
asset_policy.owner_transform_rule: The owner positions and scales every staged native asset against the locked bottom portrait in Photoshop.

rendering_policy.default: Paint texture, depth, shadows, highlights, outlines, and material response directly into each generated Scarlet asset.
rendering_policy.separate_overlay_gate: Create a separate shader or expression layer only when it must move, deform, fade, or change independently.

steps: Generate one complete anatomical Scarlet asset on a removable chroma background from the correct Scarlet reference.
Remove only the chroma background and preserve the generated alpha edge.
Trim the asset to its real alpha silhouette without resizing or registration.
Insert the native asset hidden in the semantic rig folder with an UNREGISTERED owner-transform name.
Let the owner position and scale the asset against the locked bottom portrait.
Approve identity, anatomy, edge quality, z-order, and recomposition before treating the asset as production artwork.
forbidden_operations: copying reference or structural-reference pixels into a Scarlet asset

workspace.reference_order: first in the bottom-to-top PSD child array
workspace.candidate_state: hidden and unregistered until owner placement

expressions: emotion symbols and effects above the complete character
